signing_key_path.description: Absolute path to the private signing key file (e.g., RSA/EC private key in PEM format).

signing_key_passphrase.description: Passphrase to decrypt the private key (if encrypted). Leave empty for unencrypted keys.

signing_key_id.description: Human-readable identifier for the signing key. If empty, the key's fingerprint will be used automatically.

signing_signature_ttl.description: Time-to-live for generated signatures in seconds (e.g., 31536000 = 1 year). After this, signatures expire.

signing_audiences.description: List of services or entities that are allowed to verify signatures created by this signing service. Each entry is a string identifier (e.g., service name).

verify_trusted_keys_path.description: Path to a directory containing trusted public keys (PEM format), or a file containing concatenated trusted keys.

verify_require_trusted_key.description: If true, verification fails if the signing key is not explicitly trusted. If false, falls back to allowing keys in the trusted keys path if no match is found.

verify_max_signature_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) for accepted signatures. Older signatures are rejected (e.g., 2592000 = 30 days).

verify_allowed_audiences.description: List of audience identifiers that this service will accept in incoming signatures. Must match the signing.audiences of the signing service(s) that created the signatures.
